notes.title: Version 0.017 is here!
notes.content:
My Face Your Music has updated to version 0.017. With this comes:
- Added instruments Telephone, Seashore & Helicopter, completing the MIDI meme instruments
- Custom video wall entries can now be set to <NONE>
- Extra video can now be stopped from the menu
- Slider for the size of webcam and extra video windows has more in-between values.
- Various quality of life GUI improvements
- Various bugfixes

If you haven't got MFYM yet, starting now is a 10% special discount, so come join the chaos!

notes.title: My Face Your Music is in Early Access NOW!
notes.content:
My Face Your Music has released today in Early Access, so now you can start making silly videos with my face!

 Play your own compositions with MIDI files or even MIDI devices like piano's and electronic wind instruments! But why should you stick to my face? You can now finally mod in your own (or your friend's for that matter)!

The coming months I will add more functionality in every update, so keep an eye on here and find out!

notes.title: Early Access starting 29 February 2024
notes.content:
My Face Your Music is on schedule to release in early access! Starting 29 February 2024 you can start making silly videos. 

You can already do a lot with the current package. Play your own compositions with MIDI files or even MIDI devices like piano's and electronic wind instruments! Make your own samples with your own face and if you get stuck, there is loads of documentation to help you along.

In the following months I will be adding more features and samples, so keep your eyes on here!
